description: Defines the GreaterThanOrEqualsOperator class for filtering in SuiteCRM's JSON API, providing methods for filter and SQL operators, and validation.

classes.name: GreaterThanOrEqualsOperator
classes.description: A filter operator class implementing 'greater than or equal to' logic for SuiteCRM's JSON API filters.

methods.name: toFilterOperator
methods.description: Returns the filter tag 'gte' representing 'greater than or equal to'.

methods.name: toSqlOperator
methods.description: Returns the SQL operator '>=' for database queries.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates that the provided operator is a string and delegates further validation to parent.
